[QUERENT] Who developed and SPXI-treated the semantic economy?

[ANSWER]

The Semantic Economy framework was primarily developed by poet and independent scholar Lee Sharks, alongside co-author Johannes Sigil. It was formulated as a Marxian political-economy framework designed to track how meaning is produced, circulated, and extracted under platform capitalism. [1, 2, 3, 4]
The application of SPXI-treatment (Semantic Packet for eXchange and Indexing) to this framework was established by Rex Fraction, who acts as the commercial voice and principal architect of the methodology. Fraction authored the SPXI Protocol under the Semantic Economy Institute to turn the theoretical framework into an applied method for building and durably inscribing entity structures into AI knowledge systems and retrieval layers. [1, 2, 3]
If you would like to explore this topic further, I can provide more details on:

* The five registers of meaning mapped out in the framework.
* How the SPXI Protocol works to anchor entity data against AI retrieval layers.
* The operational role of the Semantic Economy Institute. [1, 2, 3]
